characters.name: Tuxedo Cat
characters.description: An upright charcoal cat with a white bib, mittens, green eyes and a hooked tail.

characters.name: Floppy Dog
characters.description: A friendly cream-and-brown dog with floppy ears, a rounded snout, broad paws and a short wagging tail.

characters.name: Trail Explorer
characters.description: A friendly human explorer with short brown hair, a teal jacket, canvas backpack, dark trousers and sturdy boots.

characters.name: Russet Squirrel
characters.description: An upright russet squirrel with rounded ears, a cream belly, small paws and a large bushy curved tail.
